(Capacity: 12,508) |champion = |tourney = |tourney_result = }} {{2020–21 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Pittsburgh]] during the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Panthers were led by third-year head coach [[Jeff Capel III|Jeff Capel]] and played their home games at the [[Petersen Events Center]] in [[Pittsburgh]], [[Pennsylvania]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. The Panthers finished the season 10–12, 6–10 in [[2020–21 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]], to finish in twelfth place. They lost to [[2020–21 Miami Hurricanes men's basketball team|Miami]] in the first round of the [[2021 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]]. They were not invited to either the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] or [[2021 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]]. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball team|Panthers]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 16–17 overall and 6–14 in ACC play, finishing in a tie for thirteenth in the conference. The Panthers defeated [[2019–20 Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball team|Wake Forest]] in the first round of the [[2020 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] before losing to [[2019–20 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team|NC State]] in the second round. The tournament was cancelled before the Quarterfinals due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web |title=Statement from ACC on Men's Basketball Tournament |url=https://theacc.com/news/2020/3/12/statement-from-acc-on-mens-basketball-tournament.aspx |website=theacc.com |publisher=Atlantic Coast Conference |accessdate=12 March 2020}} The [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] and [[2020 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] were also cancelled due to the pandemic.{{Cite web|url=https://www.ncaa.org/about/resources/media-center/news/ncaa-cancels-remaining-winter-and-spring-championships|title=NCAA cancels remaining winter and spring championships|last=|first=|date=|website=|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200312202043/http://www.ncaa.org/about/resources/media-center/news/ncaa-cancels-remaining-winter-and-spring-championships |archive-date=2020-03-12 |access-date=}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" style="text-align:center;" !
